Full Thanksgiving Word: https://youtu.be/2_A4Gaw6-14

Ten lepers were healed on the same road, and only one came back to say thank you. Luke 17:17 asks where the nine are. Today, say thank you out loud, and make it specific.

Luke 17:17: "And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?"
Psalm 107:1: "O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever."

Type amen below. The narration voice is AI-generated and the footage is licensed stock.

#TenLepers #Thanksgiving #Luke17 #KJV #Shorts
